title: X6880-15.1.1.121SP01-OP001PF001AZ-15.1.2.128-OP001PF001AZ_20251013161008
description:
Please plug in charger to OTA upgrade when power is lower than 50%.

Update Version:
X6880-15.1.2.128(OP001PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
1. Updated Google Security Patch to October 1, 2025.
2. AI Writing: Supported intelligent recognition of email contexts for automatic optimization of format and content. Provided scenario-based text polishing for social media posts.
3. Mistouch Prevention for Pocket Mode: Optimized for the accidental touch issue in pocket mode during calls on third-party apps.
4. Battery and Power Saving: Enhanced visual design, simplified mode selection process, and improved the user experience.
5. Theme Store: Allowed changing theme designs for system apps like Phone, Contacts, and Messages.
6. Screenshot: Added a Smart Touch shortcut below the screenshot thumbnail, allowing easy recognition of QR codes on the page.
7. Optimized for the issue where the storage cleanup interface occasionally failed to refresh in real time.
8. Optimized for the occasional issue where third-party alarms did not ring.
9. Optimized for the occasional issue where a black background appeared on the home screen during fingerprint unlocking.

Fixed Issues:
1. Fixed the occasional issue of the microphone being silent during calls.
2. Fixed the issue where app updates and uninstallation could cause the app to close unexpectedly.
3. Fixed the issue where AI Eraser could not be used again after being canceled during the process.
4. Fixed the issue where users of cloned apps could not be redirected to the Barcelona Instagram page.
5. Fixed the issue where notification pop-up text was not translated under newly added languages in Guest Mode.
6. Fixed the issue where AI Gallery subtitles were displayed incorrectly.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
